name: tsws-render-worker
description: TSWS render worker: argv-only ffmpeg job runner behind a bearer token
//: No dependencies, deliberately. Only render_mark_full needs anything beyond the Node standard library (playwright plus a chromium binary), and it throws a named error when they are absent rather than failing obscurely. Installing playwright is a separate, optional step documented in DEPLOY.md. This directory sits outside the pnpm workspace globs (apps/* and packages/*), so it does not enter the root lockfile.
